segments.ja270:1.1: Sabbehi kira ñātīhi, kosiyo issaro kato;
segments.ja270:1.3: Sace ñātīhi anuññāto [ñātīhanuññāto (sī. pī.)], bhaṇeyyāhaṃ ekavācikaṃ.
segments.ja270:2.1: Bhaṇa samma anuññāto, atthaṃ dhammañca kevalaṃ;
segments.ja270:2.3: Santi hi daharā pakkhī, paññavanto jutindharā.
segments.ja270:3.1: Na me ruccati bhaddaṃ vo [bhadante (ka.)], ulūkassābhisecanaṃ;
segments.ja270:3.3: Akkuddhassa mukhaṃ passa, kathaṃ kuddho karissatīti.
segments.ja270:6.3: Atha bhaddalī kuñjara rukkha puna, kharavāca ulūkavarena dasāti.
